title: should author a banner in Settings and render it in the app header
verifies: Configure opens the editor drawer; an authored warning banner publishes and renders in the global header strip with the exact message

title: should dismiss a banner and keep it hidden across a reload
verifies: the Dismiss control removes the bar and persists the dismissal in localStorage so it stays hidden after reload

title: should render a CTA link with the authored text and URL
verifies: a banner with 'Add a link button' renders an anchor with the authored text and https href

title: should order banners by severity and suppress promo while a critical banner is up
verifies: the shared resolver orders critical > warning > info > promo and hides promo when a critical banner is active, in both preview and live bar

title: should block a banner with an empty message and recover without hanging
verifies: Apply with an empty message is rejected with the field-level error and the dialog recovers once fixed

title: should edit an existing banner and remove it (list round-trip)
verifies: editing updates a card in place, removing drops it, and publish persists only the edited banner

title: should render no dismiss control for a non-dismissible banner
verifies: a banner authored with the dismissible switch off renders no Dismiss button
